We see that TBDMSCl (Cl[Si](C)(C)(C)C) is not buyable (False). Also the longer side chain with three double bonds (OCC=CC=CC=CC(=O)O) is not buyable. So our plan fails because leaves must be commercially available.

We need to adjust leaves to be buyable chemicals.

We need to find alternative protecting group that is buyable. Maybe use "TMSCl" (trimethylsilyl chloride) which is buyable. SMILES: "Cl[Si](C)(C)C". Let's test.
